const nums: number[] = [1, 2, 3];
const strings: string[] = ["x"];
const both: (number|string)[] = [1, "x"];
const ro: readonly number[] = [1];
const suffix: [...number[], number] = [1];
const c: [number?,...number[]] = ro;
const d: [number, ...number[]] = nums;
const e: [number?] = nums;
const g: [number?,...string[]] = strings;
const h: [number?,...string[]] = both;
const o: [number, ...number[]] = suffix;
const p: [number?, ...number[]] = {length:0};
function genericBeforeOptional<T extends number[]>(values: number[]): [...T, number?] { return values; }
